integrity: Derived original phase and slope statements are distinguished from prior financial-network equations and earlier qualitative negative-correlation results. No independent validation, empirical calibration, or certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Static, bilateral, symmetric cross-equity coupling with explicitly scaled primitive external assets, homogeneous solvency threshold and distress cost, binary exchangeable shocks. Maximal equilibrium selection. Qualitative anticorrelation effects previously known in different models; publication-priority risk from broader financial-network theory. The proof is analytical; finite exact checks support only verification.
title: An exact three-regime correlation reversal in a two-firm equity contagion model
